webOnly.src/lib/decodedTiles.ts: the web's byte-bounded store of decoded tiles shared by its loaders; RadarTileStore and RadarCompositor keep the native map's
webOnly.src/lib/packPixels.ts: packs value bytes into WebGL textures
webOnly.src/lib/gpuBudget.ts: WebGL, decode and preview budgets by device class; the native caches have their own bounds
webOnly.src/lib/gpuTiles.ts: the WebGL frame layer's texture cache; the native map keeps put-together pictures in RadarCompositor
webOnly.src/layers/radarDrawing.ts: chooses between the web's WebGL frame layer and its tile layers
webOnly.src/components/ArchiveCalendar.svelte: the web's month calendar of the archive's days; the native picker is the system's graphical DatePicker bounded to them (ArchivePicker.swift)
webOnly.src/components/Wheel.svelte: the web's iOS-style drum wheel; the native picker's start is the system's time picker on the five-minute grid and its length a system Picker (ArchivePicker.swift)
webOnly.src/lib/escapeTarget.ts: tells which Escape presses are aimed at the window and not a field or dialog; a web keyboard rule, natively the system's cancel action
webOnly.src/components/ShareDialog.svelte: the web's own share dialog with a grid of services, since a browser has no reliable share sheet; the app keeps the system's share sheet and gives it the link's card (ShareCard.swift)
webOnly.src/lib/shareTargets.ts: the services' "post this" addresses for the web's share dialog; the system's share sheet lists the apps itself
webOnly.src/lib/shareSupport.ts: whether a browser or web view can share natively; the app always has the system's share sheet
webOnly.src/assets/logo.svg: the web map's logo (Logo.svelte); the app shows its own logo images
webOnly.src/assets/map-bg.webp: the map texture behind the web legend's translucent colours; the native legend lies on the chrome's tint (RadarLegend)
webOnly.src/caps/WeatherCapability.ts: dead in core: nothing registers the ICON temperature map and the backend no longer makes its tiles
webOnly.src/caps/enabled.ts: the web's switch for keeping built maps out of its UI, empty now; the native switcher lists the maps it has (LayerSwitcher.swift)
webOnly.src/components/About.svelte: the web map's About panel, opened from its logo; the app has its own About in Settings
webOnly.src/components/Appendix.svelte: the web toolbar's App Store, Play Store and GitHub links, which mean nothing inside the app
webOnly.src/components/ColorSwitcher.svelte: an empty stub in core; nothing to port
webOnly.src/components/GlassPanel.svelte: the web's frame for a text panel over the map, floating or as a sheet; the native map presents the system's sheets (NativeMapView.presentSheet)
webOnly.src/components/Icon.svelte: draws Font Awesome icons as inline SVG; the native map uses SF Symbols
webOnly.src/components/Lazy.svelte: loads the web's code-split chunks with a spinner and retry; the app carries all its code
webOnly.src/components/Logo.svelte: the web's top-left logo capsule and settings disc, hidden in the apps, which have their own
webOnly.src/components/MapLoading.svelte: veils the web's 3D map while MapLibre is fetched and its shaders compiled; the native 3D map says it is loading in its status line
webOnly.src/components/Segmented.svelte: a web control; the native map uses the system's segmented Picker
webOnly.src/layers/placeName.ts: picks the language of the web basemap's and 3D map's place labels; Apple's maps localise their own
webOnly.src/layers/protomaps.ts: the web's own Protomaps vector basemap; the native map's basemap is Apple's
webOnly.scripts/tests/basemapLayers.test.ts: tests layers/protomaps.ts's layers above and below the weather; the native basemap is Apple's
webOnly.src/layers/strikeSource.ts: batches OpenLayers' change events for the clustered strikes; not an OpenLayers source natively
webOnly.src/layers/tileMask.ts: cuts tile values by polygon on a canvas, because neither web renderer can clip a raster layer; RadarCompositor clips with Core Graphics paths
webOnly.src/layers/tileValues.ts: glue that decodes, magnifies and cuts a tile for the web's workers and MapLibre; natively RadarPixels and RadarCompositor
webOnly.src/layers/trimmedMVT.ts: trims the web basemap's Protomaps tiles before OpenLayers parses them
webOnly.src/layers/ui.ts: registers Shoelace and sets the web chrome's CSS theme and glass mode; the native chrome follows the system (ChromeTheme)
webOnly.src/layers/vector.ts: the web's Protomaps labels and borders above the radar; the native map keeps Apple's labels above it
webOnly.src/layers/weather.ts: the dead ICON temperature layer of the dead WeatherCapability
webOnly.src/layers/webglTile.ts: OpenLayers' WebGL tile layer and its lost-context recovery
webOnly.src/lib/DeviceDetect.ts: which wrapper hosts the page, a Mac's key names, the window's width breakpoint; the native map is the app and lays out by size class
webOnly.src/lib/GeolocateControl.ts: the web map's own locate disc, unused in the apps; the app's location button (ViewController.swift) does its job
webOnly.src/lib/NanobarWrapper.ts: the web's one loading bar along the top; the native map shows loading where each thing loads
webOnly.src/lib/progress.ts: drives the web's loading bar (NanobarWrapper); the native map shows loading where each thing loads
webOnly.src/lib/Router.ts: dead URL parsing, kept in core only as a debugging handle
webOnly.src/lib/ShareControl.ts: the web map's share disc; the app's own share button (ViewController.swift) shares whichever map is on screen
webOnly.src/lib/TileCache.ts: an IndexedDB precache of forecast tiles, inert in core
webOnly.src/lib/browserSupport.ts: the page's unsupported-browser flag, set by browserCheck.js
webOnly.src/lib/ctrlDrag.ts: makes a Control-drag turn MapLibre's 3D map in Firefox on a Mac
webOnly.src/lib/haptics.ts: hands the web's haptics to the native host or the Vibration API; the native map calls the system's feedback generators
webOnly.src/lib/hiddenMaps.ts: lets an off-screen OpenLayers map drop its layers' renderers; MapKit and the native caches manage their own memory
webOnly.src/lib/idleLayers.ts: lets OpenLayers' undrawn WebGL layers drop their renderers and share a tile budget; the native caches have their own bounds
webOnly.src/lib/mapMotion.ts: the web's "map is moving" signal, for its glass blur, CSS animations and slow-device timing; MapKit reports its own region changes
webOnly.*/middleDrag*: makes a middle-mouse drag act as MapLibre's right drag; the native 3D map takes UIKit's gestures
webOnly.*/nativeBridge*: the web page's side of the apps' web view bridge; the native map is not a web page (ViewController.swift is the host side)
webOnly.*/noticeLedger*: remembers which standing web toasts were dismissed for good; the only one is the web's no-WebGL notice
webOnly.src/lib/pageZoom.ts: stops iOS Safari from scaling the page
webOnly.*/ringGroups*: splits the web's single cut-wash polygon back into its networks; the native wash keeps a path per network (RadarWash, RadarCoverage)
webOnly.src/lib/safeArea.ts: measures the page's top safe-area gutter from a probe element; the native chrome uses UIKit's safe areas
webOnly.*/screenshot.*: the web page's headless screenshot mode, for the backend's Open Graph cards and notification pictures
webOnly.src/lib/sentry*.ts: the web page's Sentry error reporting; the app has no Sentry
webOnly.*/shownFailure*: groups the failures readers were shown, for Sentry; the app has no Sentry
webOnly.src/lib/serviceWorker.ts: registers the web app's service worker
webOnly.src/lib/sheetContext.ts: a Svelte context that tells a panel it sits in the phone's sheet; native sheets draw their own controls
webOnly.*/slowDevice*: times the first map drags on a touch browser to decide whether the glass goes solid while the map moves; the native map follows Reduce Transparency
webOnly.*/timedFetch*: a stall timeout the browser's fetch lacks; URLSession's request timeout is already one
webOnly.src/lib/toolbarTransition.ts: announces Svelte fly transitions so the web layout can measure again
webOnly.src/lib/viewCentre.ts: converts between OpenLayers' padded view centre and the map element's middle; MKMapView's centre is the view's middle
webOnly.scripts/tests/appApi.test.ts: tests worker/api.ts, the Worker that forwards the apps' API calls; server side
webOnly.scripts/tests/appLinks.test.ts: tests worker/appLinks.ts, the Worker's app-site association files; server side
webOnly.scripts/tests/chooseLocale.test.ts: tests locale/choose.ts, the web's choice of language from the URL and the browser; the app speaks the system's language (CoreStrings)
webOnly.scripts/tests/licences.test.ts: tests scripts/licences.mjs, core's build tooling; the app has its own scripts/licences.py
webOnly.scripts/tests/networkEvents.test.ts: tests api/events.ts's split of the network event's names into countries and frames; the native map fetches the whole series again on any of them (RadarEngine)
webOnly.scripts/tests/frameStores.test.ts: guards against a Svelte store glitch between the frame and its liveness; natively they are one value (RadarStep)
webOnly.scripts/tests/satelliteBasemap.test.ts: tests layers/satellite.ts's crop of a VersaTiles tile's ancestor, which Apple's imagery does without; that the imagery counts as a dark basemap holds natively (NativeMapView.applyBaseMap)

unported.src/layers/radarFrames.ts: the WebGL2 frame layer. Its switching whole, same-step stand-ins, rest and previews are ported (RadarEngine, RadarOverlay, lib/frameSwitch.ts, lib/previewTiles.ts); its crossfade in value across a step's 450 ms (radarCrossfade, CROSSFADE_MS) is not: the native map colours tiles before putting a step together, and MapKit's tile-by-tile overlay redraws cannot dissolve every animation frame without a GPU renderer
unported.src/urls.ts: production hosts follow the Flanders cutover; decided by the owner
unported.src/components/MeetYouCool.svelte: deferred by the owner; an easter egg reachable only by #meetyoucool
unported.src/lib/meetYouCool*.ts: deferred by the owner; an easter egg reachable only by #meetyoucool
unported.scripts/tests/meetYouCool.test.ts: deferred by the owner; an easter egg reachable only by #meetyoucool
unported.src/lib/minimapBasemap.ts: the storm panel's radar minimap (StormInside.RadarMinimap) draws no coasts or borders under its rings
unported.*/radarHorizons*: the storm panel's radar minimap does not shade how far each radar really sees once terrain is counted
unported.*/recovery*: the native map does not probe again an endpoint that failed for the network's sake, nor resync when the network comes back; it refetches when the socket reconnects or the app comes back
